_comment: Donation addresses for the Support hosting section of the downloads page (tools/build_site.py). This is the only place they live: the page text, copy buttons and QR codes are all built from these strings, and each QR encodes the address exactly as written here. Keep the Ethereum mixed-case checksum and the bech32 Bitcoin address as they are; tests/test_build_site.py checks both checksums.
